answer: Make coordinated grading unprovable, MACI style. Jurors submit grades encrypted to a coordinator, and any juror may later send a secret key-change message that silently replaces its earlier vote. Only the final tally is published, with a zero-knowledge proof that it was counted correctly. A farm that rents or controls jurors can never confirm they voted as told, since any one may have overridden its vote in private. Buying a bloc becomes a voyage past the horizon of what can be checked, so collusion markets lose their plume of value.
